threshold_note: 0.1 and 0.5 are descriptive diagnostics only; the production candidate selector has no such threshold. Prior scores are top-3-window sigmoid averages, not calibrated video probabilities.
pipeline_note: VideoMAE and CLIP rank windows for every class; VLM classifies all six classes independently from images. Postprocessing preserves each nonempty class and searches boundaries, not relabeling.
